A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of the same R3DM paper. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SMAC and SMACv2 experiments, including performance curves, qualitative strategy analysis, and ablations in Section 5 and Figures 2–5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original SMAC and SMACv2 experimental results, qualitative analysis, and ablations in Section 5 and Figures 2–5.

M1.justification: The contrastive role-learning procedure, role-conditioned and role-agnostic dynamics models, intrinsic rewards, and learning objective are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six SMAC maps and six SMACv2 scenarios covering protoss, terran, and zerg with 5-versus-5 and 10-versus-11 teams. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Figures 2 and 3 retain the same comparisons against ACORM, GoMARL, CIA, CDS, QMIX, and EMC. Comparator membership within the reported experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: The game version, metrics, training budgets, and experimental settings are unchanged. Appendix B retains evaluation every 5,000 updates using 32 episodes and the same settings in Tables 1–4.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the qualitative role and strategy comparison with ACORM in Figure 4 and the imagination-horizon, role-cardinality, and contrastive-learning ablations in Figure 5.

E5.justification: Both versions specify the same five random seeds and report means with standard-deviation shading in Figure 3. No repeated-run information or statistical reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: The performance and ablation plots in Figures 2, 3, and 5 contain identical results. Figure 4 and the accompanying qualitative findings also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorems 4.1–4.3, proofs in Appendix A, and intrinsic-reward derivations in Appendix B.5 are unchanged. Extraction-spacing differences do not represent mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions linking roles to past and future trajectories, along with the same claim of up to 20% improvement in win rates.

C2.justification: The interpretations of coordination, exploration, and ablation outcomes are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning predefined role counts and local dynamics models that omit other agents' actions and roles.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same architecture descriptions, hyperparameters, training instructions, and DreamerV3 implementation reference. The R3DM code-access information and Appendix C pseudocode are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The existing Zhang et al. CoordLight reference gains volume, issue, pages, month, and DOI metadata; this is an update to the same work, not a new citation.

P1.justification: v2 updates capitalization and publication details in the CoordLight bibliography entry and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative, section structure, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer CoordLight reference slightly reflows the right column on page 11 and shifts subsequent references. Figures 1–5, Tables 1–4, and their presentation remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides a fuller citation for an already identifiable reference, with slight bibliography reflow. The scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so this editorial update does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
